code: case UA_MESSAGETYPE_HEL: retval = processHEL(server, connection, message, &offset);
note: PoC starts with HEL chunk; dummy connection becomes UA_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
OPN chunk with SecurityPolicy#None creates SecureChannel, channelId=1 tokenId=1
CreateSessionRequest (id 461) creates a session via UA_SessionManager_createSession
ActivateSessionRequest (id 467) activates the session (fuzz mode reuses stored auth token)
CreateMonitoredItemsRequest (id 751) creates monitored item id 1 on ServerStatus/State
DeleteMonitoredItemsRequest (id 781) removes item 1; its delayedFreePointers M1d is enqueued -> queue [M1d]
CloseSessionRequest (id 473) -> Service_CloseSession -> UA_SessionManager_removeSession -> removeSession enqueues session cleanup callback A at head -> queue [A, M1d]
Harness calls UA_Server_run_shutdown: first cleanup pass drains delayed-callback queue

Pass 1 processes A: removeSessionCallback -> UA_Session_deleteMembersCleanup -> UA_Session_deleteSubscription -> UA_Subscription_deleteMembers -> UA_WorkQueue_enqueueDelayed(&sub->delayedFreePointers) re-enqueues Sd onto the queue being processed; then UA_free(A)
Next loop iteration dc is the pre-computed next (M1d); SIMPLEQ_REMOVE_HEAD removes the re-enqueued Sd instead; M1d is freed but remains linked in delayedCallbacks queue
Harness then calls UA_Server_delete: second cleanup pass drains the queue again
Pass 2 dereferences the dangling M1d (SIMPLEQ_NEXT / dc->callback) -> heap-use-after-free / double free
